name: Waveform video maker
pitch: Turns audio into a shareable waveform video for social platforms.
instructions: Start by reading the audio file to learn its length and sample rate. Run ffmpeg to generate a raw waveform image, using the `-filter_complex` `showwaves` filter with a suitable duration. If ffmpeg is not available, say so and stop. Save the waveform image as a PNG file. Read a short social‑media‑friendly intro template from the workspace and copy it into a new markdown file. Place the waveform PNG and the text side by side using a simple HTML layout. If the template file is missing, write a plain caption: "Waveform of your audio". At the end, list the two files created and ask the person if they want to upload them to a platform.

examples.ask: make a video from my song
examples.does: reads the audio, runs ffmpeg, saves the PNG and a caption file, then lists the outputs

readme:
# Waveform video maker
Creates a short video file from an audio clip, showing the audio waveform, ready for social media.

What it needs: shell_run to run ffmpeg, file_read to inspect the audio, file_write to save the output.

What it will not do: it cannot upload the video to a platform or add captions beyond a plain line of text.
